Name: "Kop van Isselt" and "Ocriet eiland" housing projects (2,600 homes)
Description: Construction of approximately 2,500 homes in Kop van Isselt and about 100 homes on Ocriet eiland.

Name: "Nieuwe stad" and "Wagenwerkplaats" housing projects (1,400 homes)
Description: Construction of about 800 new homes in Nieuwe stad/Eemplein and roughly 600 homes in Wagenwerkplaats.

Name: A1/A30 Barneveld
Description: Capacity expansion and junction modifications at the A1/A30 interchange near Barneveld to improve traffic flow, including a new connecting curve.

Name: A1/A6/A9 Schiphol-Amsterdam-Almere
Description: Massive highway expansion across five segments, including tunnels, sunken road sections, and an eco-aquaduct to improve regional accessibility.

Name: A10 Knooppunten De Nieuwe Meer en Amstel
Description: Reconstruction and capacity expansion of the De Nieuwe Meer and Amstel highway interchanges to separate local and through traffic.

Name: A2 Het Vonderen-Kerensheide
Description: Structural widening of a 20-kilometer highway stretch from rush-hour lanes to full 2x3 lanes with hard shoulders, plus junction fly-over expansion.

Name: A2/N2
Description: Integral exploration for capacity expansion of the A2/N2 highway on the west side of Eindhoven, alongside the development of a Brainportlijn transit corridor and northwest access roads.

Name: A20 Nieuwerkerk a/d IJssel-Knooppunt Gouwe
Description: Widening the A20 from 2x2 to 2x3 lanes and extending a third lane to improve throughput and safety.

Name: A27 Houten-Hooipolder
Description: The 47-kilometer highway will be renewed with additional peak and regular lanes, new viaducts, and the replacement of the Hagesteinsebrug, Merwedebrug, and Keizersveerbrug.

Name: A28 Amersfoort-Hoogeveen
Description: A package of targeted infrastructure measures, dynamic traffic management, and incident management along the A28 corridor to improve safety and flow.

Name: A7/A8 Amsterdam-Hoorn
Description: The project aims to resolve mobility bottlenecks on the A7/A8 corridor between Amsterdam and Hoorn using a combination of mobility measures and targeted infrastructure upgrades without fully relying on new road construction.

Name: Baarlo-Hout-Blerick
Description: Water safety and river widening project integrating major dike reinforcement, dike relocation to give the river more space, and stream restoration.

Name: Bereikbaarheid Ameland
Description: Exploration of long-term solutions for the ferry connection between Holwert and Ameland, which may include relocating the port to Ferwert, extending the pier by 1.5 kilometers, or adjusting the shipping channel dimensions.

Name: Besluit Beheer Haringvlietsluizen
Description: Altering the management of the Haringvliet sluices to allow for fish migration and the relocation of freshwater intake points to adapt to changing estuary salinity.

Name: Brainportregio Eindhoven
Description: Multimodal transport node development including expanding Eindhoven Central station, building the HOV4 line, and developing Knoop XL and HOV-4 areas with 11,500 homes planned until 2030 and nearly 10,000 more after 2030.

Name: Calandbrug (Theemswegtrac√©)
Description: Construction of a new elevated freight rail route (Theemswegtrac√©) to bypass the bridge, followed by a large-scale renovation of the existing Calandbrug for road traffic.

Name: Capaciteitsuitbreiding ligplaatsen Amsterdam - Lemmer
Description: The initiative investigates and implements the expansion, improvement, and restructuring of mooring and waiting berths for ships along the waterway between Amsterdam and Lemmer.

Name: Derde perron Amsterdam Zuid
Description: The project creates space for rail expansion by constructing a third platform with approach tracks, turnback tracks, and a new passenger terminal for non-Schengen travelers at Amsterdam Zuid.

Name: Development of the area "Langs Eem en Spoor"
Description: A mixed‚Äëuse development comprising several subareas along the Eem, including housing and office blocks.

Name: Dijkversterking Marken
Description: Reinforcing the Westkade and Zuidkade dikes of the Marken peninsula outward to resolve stability and height deficits.

Name: Ecologische Waterkwaliteit Friese IJsselmeerkust
Description: Ecological water quality project along the Frisian IJsselmeer coast involving small-scale measures like the creation of shallow zones, sheltered areas, and fish passages.

Name: Eemszijlen/Groote Polder
Description: Creation of approximately 40 hectares of estuarine nature inside the dikes to strengthen nature, economy, and livability.

Name: Elektrificatie Almelo-Mari√´nberg en Zutphen-Hengelo-Oldenzaal
Description: Electrification of regional railway lines Almelo-Mari√´nberg and Zutphen-Hengelo-Oldenzaal to replace older diesel train fleets with zero-emission trains.

Name: Emplacement Den Haag Centraal
Description: Reconfiguration of the Den Haag Centraal railway yard to handle increased train frequencies, including reconnecting platforms 11 and 12 and adjusting the track layout.

Name: EuregioRail: Zwolle - Twente - M√ºnster
Description: Electrification of the railway track between Enschede and the German border, and the through-connection of trains at Enschede station.

Name: Gebiedsontwikkeling Vierwaarden
Description: Water safety project combining dike reinforcements and river widening along the Maas north of Venlo.

Name: Goederenroute Elst-Deventer-Twente (NaNOV)
Description: Upgrades to the existing freight rail route including the replacement of level crossings with underpasses and the installation of noise barriers.

Name: Grensmaas
Description: River widening, gravel extraction, and nature development along the Maas to lower high-water levels and achieve a 1:250 flood protection level.

Name: HOV-Net Zuid-Holland Noord
Description: Development of a high-quality regional public transport network consisting of two train corridors and six bus corridors, including the construction of new stations and dedicated bus lanes.

Name: Hub 's-Hertogenbosch
Description: Integral upgrade of the 's-Hertogenbosch station area including a new platform, traverse, and bus station, in conjunction with building 4,800 homes by 2030 and an estimated 10,000 homes post-2030.

Name: Inframaatregelen MerwedeLingeLijn
Description: Infrastructure upgrades on the MerwedeLingeLijn (Dordrecht to Geldermalsen) to accommodate ERTMS, including platform extensions and power supply changes.

Name: Koehool-Lauwersmeer
Description: Ecological improvement project focused on creating fish passages, inland breeding areas, and optimizing salt marshes along the Wadden Sea coast.

Name: Lauwersmeer-Vierhuizergat
Description: Installation of a tidal culvert to create 70 hectares of estuarine habitat, alongside the construction of offshore salt marshes and tidal reefs.

Name: Lelylijn
Description: An investigation into a major new railway connection designed to strengthen the economy, housing development, and accessibility between the Randstad and Northern Netherlands.

Name: Lob van Gennep
Description: Enhancement of water safety in a 20-square-kilometer area by improving water retention capacity during extreme high water levels along the Meuse river.

Name: Maaslijn
Description: Electrification of the entire single-track railway line between Nijmegen, Venlo, and Roermond, including the construction of extra tracks at several locations to allow trains to pass.

Name: Maasroute, Modernisering fase 2
Description: Upgrading the waterway to Class Vb, increasing bridge clearance heights, widening the Elsloo bend, and creating passing lanes in the Julianakanaal to improve lock capacity and ship flow.

Name: Meanderende Maas
Description: Reinforcement of 26 kilometers of dikes on the Brabant side of the Maas between Ravenstein and Lith, combined with river widening and the creation of 600 hectares of new nature.

Name: Multimodale knoop Schiphol
Description: This project tackles capacity bottlenecks by upgrading the train platforms, stairs, escalators, bus station, and the main plaza hall to accommodate growing passenger streams up to the year 2035.

Name: N35 Wijthmen-Nijverdal
Description: An exploration to upgrade the N35 road between Wijthmen and Nijverdal to improve traffic safety and flow, potentially upgrading it to an expressway.

Name: Nijmegen omarmt de Waal (Waalfront)
Description: Urban transformation of a 33-hectare industrial area into a new residential and commercial district containing approximately 2,100 homes.

Name: Noord-Hollandse Markermeerkust
Description: Creating and improving habitats for birds and fish along the Markermeer coast across multiple locations to strengthen the ecosystem.

Name: Oeffelt
Description: Resolving a river bottleneck by widening the flow opening at the bridge by 250 meters and lowering the adjacent floodplain by 1 meter.

Name: Oostvaardersoevers
Description: Connecting regional lakes and wetlands into a robust ecosystem using innovative waterworks, including a fish passage and shallow zones in the Markermeer.

Name: OV knooppunt Nijmegen Centrumzijde & Fietsenstalling
Description: Redevelopment of the public transport hub at Nijmegen station, including a new station hall, bus square, and an expanded underground bicycle parking facility.

Name: OV-verbinding Amsterdam - Haarlemmermeer
Description: A new public transport connection to relieve the national railway network and Schiphol tunnel, unlocking new residential (325,000) and work locations.

Name: OV-verbinding Sloterdijk - Amsterdam Centrum
Description: Development of a public transport connection, including closing the metro Ring line, to facilitate the development of over 53,000 homes and 48,000 workplaces in Haven-Stad Zuid.

Name: PHS Alkmaar-Amsterdam
Description: Upgrading the corridor for high-frequency trains, including a new stabling yard in Heerhugowaard, station reconfiguration at Uitgeest, and level crossing adaptations.

Name: PHS Amsterdam
Description: Major capacity expansion at Amsterdam Centraal, including widening platforms, expanding passenger tunnels, and modifying tracks and switches.

Name: PHS Ede
Description: Modification of the Ede-Wageningen railway station to support high-frequency rail, adding an extra platform, perron tracks, and expanding transfer capacity.

Name: PHS Meteren-Boxtel
Description: Capacity expansion on the Amsterdam-Eindhoven rail corridor, including a new connection curve at Meteren, a fourth track and a grade-separated crossing between Den Bosch and Vught, and a sunken railway section in Vught.

Name: PHS Nijmegen
Description: Functional upgrades to Nijmegen station including increased transfer capacity, new platforms, track adjustments, and a new western entrance.

Name: PHS Rijswijk-Rotterdam
Description: Expansion of the railway track from two to four tracks between Rijswijk and Delft Zuid, including tunnel expansion and yard layout modifications between Schiedam and Rotterdam.

Name: Pilot Buitendijkse Slibsedimentatie
Description: A pilot project to naturally extract sludge from the water column outside the dikes to reduce turbidity and improve the ecological quality of the Eems-Dollard estuary.

Name: Project Mainportontwikkeling Rotterdam
Description: A mega-project featuring the land reclamation of 1,000 hectares for new port area (Tweede Maasvlakte), deepening of the Nieuwe Waterweg, and the creation of 750 hectares of nature compensation.

Name: Randstadrail/Metronet
Description: Upgrading existing regional transit corridors by coupling RandstadRail vehicles, increasing Metro line frequencies, renewing signaling, and expanding Station Beurs.

Name: RegioExpres
Description: Realization of a fast train service between Arnhem, Doetinchem, and Winterswijk, requiring the construction of additional double track to increase capacity and support 25,000 new regional homes.

Name: Rijnlandroute
Description: Construction of a new regional highway (N434) and the widening of existing roads (A44, N206) between Katwijk and Leiden, including bored tunnels and new junctions.

Name: Rivierklimaatpark IJsselpoort
Description: A river climate park focusing on water safety, nature, and recreation, which includes significant river widening measures between Arnhem and Doesburg.

Name: Station Groningen Suiker
Description: Construction of a new train station and infrastructure adjustments to unlock the De Suikerzijde area, which includes 4,300 homes until 2030 and 3,800 homes after 2030.

Name: Toekomstvast Spoor Zuidoost-NL
Description: Integral rail network upgrade including the construction of 740-meter waiting tracks for freight trains in Venlo and the adaptation of track bundles at the Eindhoven rail yard.

Name: Traject Oost
Description: Various capacity and safety upgrades along the Utrecht-Arnhem rail corridor, with the remaining major work being a railway underpass in Maarsbergen.

Name: Vaarweg Lemmer-Delfzijl, fase 2
Description: Upgrading the main waterway to accommodate class Va ships, including the replacement of eight bridges and implementation of remote-controlled industrial automation.

Name: Verbeteren vaargeul IJsselmeer (Amsterdam - Lemmer)
Description: Deepening the shipping channel in the IJsselmeer to accommodate class Vb inland vessels, primarily achieved through sand extraction concessions.

Name: Verruiming Sluiscomplex Kornwerderzand
Description: Widening of the Kornwerderzand lock complex, replacement of adjacent bridges, and deepening of navigation channels to accommodate larger sea-going vessels.

Name: Well
Description: Construction of a 'Green River' bypass alongside dike reinforcements to significantly lower water levels downstream and improve overall safety.

Name: Zandsuppletie Galgeplaat
Description: A large-scale sand nourishment project on the Galgeplaat tidal flat to combat erosion and preserve the ecological and recreational value of the Oosterschelde.

Name: Zeetoegang IJmond
Description: Construction of a new, 70-meter wide sea lock at IJmuiden and implementation of selective extraction measures to prevent salinization.

Name: Zuidasdok
Description: Placing the A10 Zuid highway underground into tunnels and significantly expanding the Amsterdam Zuid public transport terminal.

Name: Zuidelijk Maasdal
Description: Project addressing water safety (dike reinforcement, river widening) and nautical safety (upgrading the Maas to class Vb) in Maastricht, plus a new slow-traffic bridge.

Name: Afsluitdijk
Description: Reinforcing the 32-kilometer dike structure, strengthening existing locks, and expanding water discharge capacity at Den Oever.

Name: MIRT-verkenning OV en Wonen
Description: Improvement of the public transport system, including the Merwedelijn tram, to unlock approximately 85,000 new homes in the Utrecht region.
